data.action: 反坐高木椅，一只脚跟抬到椅面，手指卷住袜口，身体轻靠椅背
data.description: 【洛琪希 · 白丝与油灯】昏暗书房里，成年洛琪希仅穿纯白过膝袜反坐在高木椅上，一只脚跟抬到椅面，手指卷住袜口，身体轻靠椅背。油灯照着她低头羞赧的神情——「为什么特意让我换上这双白色长袜呢？……要是你真的喜欢看的话，随你怎么看都可以哦。」
data.promptProse: Adult Roxy sits backward on the chair with one heel raised onto the seat, rolling down the stocking welt while resting against the backrest. Her raised foot and the stocking welt remain the focus of the frame.
data.title: 洛琪希 · 白丝与油灯
data.animaCaption: One heel rests on the chair seat as her fingers roll down the stocking welt against the backrest.
